style: fantasy East Asian adventure world, vibrant saturated colors, fun and bold like a modern indie game, pixel art

arenas.a-temple: misty mountain temple at dawn, tiered pagoda roofs on a cliff, pink cherry blossom trees, soft golden sunrise light, layered mountains fading into mist, open flat stone courtyard in the foreground for a battle
arenas.b-bamboo: deep green bamboo forest with a calm river and an arched stone bridge, sunbeams through the leaves, fireflies, wide flat grassy riverbank in the foreground for a battle
arenas.c-sky: floating sky islands at sunset with glowing paper lanterns drifting in the air, waterfalls falling off the islands, orange and purple clouds, wide flat floating stone platform in the foreground for a battle

1.extra: impressionistic painterly brush strokes, dreamy soft light

2.extra: crisp clean pixel art, sharp detail

skins.d-monk: young monk hero with a wooden fighting staff, orange and yellow robes, determined smile, full body
skins.e-fox: fox spirit archer with fox ears and a fluffy tail, red and white outfit, holding a glowing bow, full body
skins.f-dragon: dragon knight in shiny jade green armor with a dragon head helmet, holding a spear, full body
skins.g-lantern: lantern mage kid in a dark blue hooded cloak holding a glowing paper lantern staff, magic sparks, full body

shopkeepers.h-merchant: friendly old merchant with a long white beard and a round straw hat, big cheerful grin, holding an abacus, full body
shopkeepers.i-panda: red panda shopkeeper standing upright in a tea house apron, holding a steaming teapot, cheerful, full body

items.j-sword: curved sword with a red silk tassel on the handle, single item
items.k-armor: jade green armor chest plate with gold trim, single item
items.l-gourd: health potion in a gourd bottle with glowing red liquid and a cork, single item
items.m-coin: gold coin with a square hole in the center, single item
items.n-bigcoin: large special rainbow crystal coin with a glowing dragon emblem and sparkles, single item
